HOW TO USE

A 5–10 MINUTE
REPAIR RITUAL

After shampooing, apply a generous amount to clean, damp hair. Massage evenly from mid-lengths to ends, focusing on the most damaged areas.

  • Apply to clean, damp hair
  • Leave on for 5–10 minutes
  • Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water
  • Use 1–2 times per week
